title: The Burned Saint
text: The Court has burned a statue of a saint and left it in the square, blackened and cracked, its hands still raised in blessing. By day the crowds spit on it. By night pilgrims creep in to touch it, and the soot on their fingers never washes off.

options.label: Creep in and touch it, with the pilgrims.

outcomes.text: It is still warm under the soot, and the warmth goes into you like comfort.

options.label: The strongest carries it out of the Court.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims cheer. The Court notices, and sends its people after you.

options.label: Report the pilgrims to the Court.

outcomes.text: The Court rewards you in silver. The pilgrims weep, and are taken away, and you hear them a long time.
